# Focus stacking lens check

The function that decides whether a lens may be used for focus stacking; its per-lens flag branch is the patch point.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x6065e5d6` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

The one function that references the debug string fcs_check_focus_stacking_enable. It checks the lens type, then a per-lens flag, and the branch after the flag check is the one replaced. The lens-type check is shared with eight other callers and is left alone.

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): With the branch replaced by two no-ops, focus stacking runs with lenses outside the stock list. Source: [Focus stacking lens check patch](../sources/em5n.focus-patch.md).
